visual.general_description: Grayscale sagittal magnetic resonance image of the neck and upper back region with overlaid acquisition text.
visual.detailed_description: Grayscale sagittal view that appears to be a photograph of a display, with slight blur and perspective distortion. A column of stacked vertebral bodies with dark intervertebral discs runs from the upper left to the lower centre. A bright band of fluid-like signal runs along the spinal canal behind the vertebral bodies, with a mid-grey band lying alongside it. Posterior to the spine are muscle and soft tissue layers, and the skin outline of the back of the neck curves along the right side against a dark background. Overlaid white text with a black outline reads "Echo Numbers: 1, Ec" and is cut off at the right image edge, and a single small letter "I" is visible near the lower centre. No arrows, circles, scale bars, measurement marks or panel letters are visible, and the collection described in the caption is not separately marked.

evidence.quote:
Figure 1
MRI showing a posterior extradural collection.

Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) performed two days after admission showed mild peripheral enhancement in the lower cervical and upper thoracic regions, with a posterior extradural collection extending from cervical(C) 3 down to dorsal(D) 6, as shown in Figure 1.

Stacked vertebral bodies with dark intervertebral discs; a bright fluid-like band and a mid-grey band run along the spinal canal behind them.
Overlaid white text with black outline reading "Echo Numbers: 1, Ec", cut off at the right edge, and a small letter "I" near the lower centre.

caption_claims.value: Caption states the MRI shows a posterior extradural collection; the text gives the collection reaching 8 mm anteroposterior at C6/C7 and an extent of C3 to D6 (the abstract gives C3 to T7). These are source claims, not measured from the image.

limitations: The collection is not marked in the image and could not be separately identified from the pixels; the description relies on the caption for it.
Sequence type, vertebral levels, laterality and orientation labels are not printed beyond the cut-off text and a single letter.
